items.title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
items.description: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

items.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
items.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.

items.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East  worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
items.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

items.title: Rhine falls to record low levels as drought strains Europe's rivers
items.description: Low water levels in the Rhine, Danube and Po have curtailed the transport of goods and reduced electricity output.

items.title: US reports first two deaths linked to  'explosive diarrhoea' outbreak
items.description: The illness caused by parasitic infection that spreads through contaminated food or water is not generally life-threatening, health officials say.

items.title: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings
items.description: Ursula von der Leyen has called for action ahead of an urgent EU interior ministers meeting to discuss the issue.

items.title: Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa
items.description: Opponents of Fifa president Gianni Infantino are threatening "non co-operation" with the governing body unless he steps down, according to senior Uefa sources.

items.title: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
items.description: Photos newly released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi meeting with an ICRC official.

items.title: Two workers killed in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japan mall on boss' order
items.description: The two women's employer has apologised for sending them back to Aeon Mall to secure cash.

items.title: Russian anti-war politician says he has fled the country
items.description: Boris Nadezhdin, who was recently designated as a foreign agent, posted a video in front of the Eiffel Tower.

items.title: US and Japan take action to prop up yen in rare joint move
items.description: Both countries have said that they will not hesitate to conduct joint interventions in the future.

items.title: Sudan army drone strike on court session kills 35, rights group says
items.description: The army has not commented on claims that civilians died in the attack on a paramilitary-held village.
